annotations.text:
Convexa 1.0.0

The version this canvas shows (the root package.json’s). The publish step adds the commit, the date and the release status.

Convexa Design: every screen of Convexa in its current, ruled design, on 13 pages (organized by app area 2026-10-28).

Pages: the app in its navigation order, Scanner (the ranked read of the whole universe) · Ticker desk (the desk, its AI read, and the Technical and Research tabs) · Research (Notes, Markets with its Stress and Liquidity sections, Filings and Scorecard) · Positions & alerts (the simulated book, and alerts on public data); then the pages around it, Settings & operator (Settings, and the operator’s unlinked pages) · Dialogs & overlays (every dialog, drawer and sheet) · Public site (landing, methodology, blog, sources and credits, privacy, terms and the 404) · Shell & foundations (the shell, data states and charts, and the token and component library); then the planned work and the unruled prototypes, Planned · Trade journal (spec 08: seven screens under Positions, and its panel in Settings) · Planned · Public-data tools (the eight planned tools from public data) · Prototypes · not ruled (F2, a year of the curve, and F3, calibration); and Changelog (design changes up to each Convexa version).

Each row is one screen, left to right: its spec card (purpose, where every number comes from, states, acceptance, what is built), then staging (the demo account, all sample), production where it differs, phone, light, and its states.

Versions: each release of Convexa has a version, the root package.json’s (the first, 1.0.0, is the first push after 2026-10-28), and the version card states the version and commit this canvas shows. Each built row’s title and spec card name the version it first shipped in (“since Convexa 1.0.0”), and the Changelog page lists the design changes up to each version. To see the design as of any release, build design/ at its tag (a worktree at v1.0.0, then node design/src/build.mjs there).

Ruled questions, fixed issues and the earlier rounds (v2–v5 directions, audits and before/after boards) are off the canvas: the record is git, design/CHANGELOG.md and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md Amendments.

Start here · Convexa 1.0.0

The board map (every screen by page: what’s built, and the Convexa version it first shipped in) and the screen tracker (what’s open on each screen, and why); the version card and the guide sit to their right.

Scanner · Convexa 1.0.0

The Scanner: one dense read of the tracked universe, ranked by dealer structure, signed out and signed in.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Ticker desk · Convexa 1.0.0

One ticker: the desk, its AI read in depth, and the Technical and Research tabs.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Research · Convexa 1.0.0

The Research section: the Notes index, Markets and its Stress and Liquidity sections, Filings and the Scorecard. A single note (/ticker/:symbol/research, which the nav also lights as Research) is on Ticker desk, as the ticker’s Research tab.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Positions & alerts · Convexa 1.0.0

Positions, the simulated book and how past decisions closed, and Alerts on public sources.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Settings, and the operator’s two unlinked pages: the bundle’s stage timings and the stored session books.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Public site · Convexa 1.0.0

The public pages: landing, methodology, the blog, data sources and credits, privacy, terms, and the 404 with the route fallback.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Shell & foundations · Convexa 1.0.0

The global shell around every page, the foundations every screen keeps (data states, the chart system, third-party frames), and the token and component library.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Planned · Trade journal

The trade journal (spec 08): seven screens under Positions’ tabs, from the timeline on, and its panel in Settings. Designed but in no Convexa release yet; this canvas shows Convexa 1.0.0.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Planned · Public-data tools

The eight planned tools from public data, each with its spec card. Liquidity, which shipped inside Markets, is on the Research page. Designed but in no Convexa release yet as screens of their own (parts of several already ship inside their host pages; the board map shows how much); this canvas shows Convexa 1.0.0.

Read each row left to right: the spec card, then staging, production where it differs, phone, light and states.

Prototypes · not ruled

Two v5 frontier prototypes the owner has not ruled on, F2 (a year of the Treasury curve) and F3 (calibration you can question), each board drawing its designed fallback; the prototypes run in design/site. Designed but in no Convexa release yet; this canvas shows Convexa 1.0.0.

Changelog · Convexa 1.0.0

Every design/CHANGELOG.md entry, newest first, as the design changes up to each Convexa version. A change up to a version is in the canvas that version’s tag builds; it doesn’t say the screen it draws ships (the planned pages say which don’t).
